summary: Validated GHG period row-limit implementation with focused backend regression and frontend bulk upload smoke. All targeted tests passed, including added unlimited monthly_rows_allowed regression coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: Verified period-specific guard wiring in manual GHG create, C7 monthly/yearly create, bulk preview filtering, direct bulk save, and confirm-save recheck paths via code review and focused tests.
Pre-existing maintainability risk remains: /app/backend/server.py is very large (>700 lines guideline), but no blocking defect found for this feature scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed pytest on /app/backend/tests/test_ghg_period_row_limits.py (7/7 passed). Added regression test for unlimited monthly_rows_allowed behavior. UI smoke validated authenticated load of /uploads/bulk and no rendering break for bulk upload page; validation action controls are conditional and not present until a validation result exists.
